places-straubing-ostkastell-watchtowers-.story: A 308 km round trip from Straubing - roughly 5 h 19 in the saddle. It goes by way of Regensburg - Östliche Canabae, Weltenburg‐Am Galget - Kleinkastell, Fort site and civil settlement of Kösching and Watchtowers WP 14/63 to 14/78 including fo. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
